metadata.goal: Read a directory of source files and produce a code health report listing files with high complexity, missing docstrings, or long functions, written to output/ as a markdown report
degradation_warnings: Antigravity uses dynamic subagents — per-step model assignment is not supported. Only the orchestrator's model tier is user-configurable. Subagent model selection is owned by Antigravity's orchestrator.
metadata.platform_note: All step agents use model_tier: inherit. The orchestrator_tier (fast) resolves to the fast-tier model per the tier_1c profile (see skills/sk-platform-dispatch/profiles/tier_1c.json). Per-step intent is recorded in model_intent_scaffold_tier for cross-tier portability.

steps.description: Reads source files in the target directory, extracts per-file metrics for complexity, missing docstrings, and long functions, writes metrics to temp state.
Reads scanner metrics, renders a structured markdown code health report, writes the final output file.
